answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, expired if not renewed by fresh work. The ivory holds work receipts rather than names, so the spiral of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The umber of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
